name: Erosion Aura
body:
Erosion Aura (Su)
Source Ultimate Magic pg. 33
At 8th level, you can project an aura of magically enhanced erosion as a standard action. Objects made primarily of metal or stone within this aura lose 10 points of hardness. Magic items retain a minimum hardness equal to twice their enhancement bonus and can attempt a Fortitude saving throw (DC = 10 + half your druid level + your Wisdom modifier) to negate this effect. A construct made primarily of metal or stone must succeed at a Fortitude save or lose all damage reduction and hardness for 1 round. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.
Domain Spells: 1st—expeditious excavation, 2nd— soften earth and stone, 3rd—disable construct, 4th—rusting grasp, 5th—transmute rock to mud, 6th—sympathetic vibration, 7th—disintegrate, 8th—earthquake, 9th—implosion.
